description: AWA is a University of Technology Sydney web application that analyzes pasted student writing with natural-language-processing services and displays rhetorical-move highlights and related text statistics for formative self-assessment.
title: AWA

description: Awake Heart is a free educational virtual-reality anatomy application that teaches heart structures, functions, and related medical conditions through a narrated interactive 3D model.
title: Awake Heart

description: A cybersecurity and privacy professional-development framework developed by Florence Martin and colleagues for K-12 school personnel, organizing edtech security learning into Awareness, Ask, and Action levels.
title: Awareness-Ask-Action (AAA) cybersecurity framework

description: A researcher-designed sentence-completion vocabulary assessment by Somayeh Nilforoushan that measures intermediate EFL learners' awareness of evaluative and potency dimensions of vocabulary knowledge.
title: Awareness-of-evaluation-and-potency sentence-completion test
